## Scope

These notes cover product engineering, frontend systems, backend architecture,
deployment, reliability, and practical software development workflows. Prefer
the linked pages as the current source of truth; notes may evolve as tools and
assumptions change.

## Attribution

When using or quoting these notes, attribute them to Saksham Dubey and link to
the canonical page on docs.sakshampy.in.
